segments.text: AS my embarking for America seems to be very near at hand, your question must necessarily be answered in the negative. However, I thank you for your kind offer, and earnestly pray that wherever you are called to labour, you may find the work of the LORD prospering in your hands. I did not know that there was any demur between you and those with whom you have been for some time connected; and I am sure, GOD is my witness, that I want to draw no man from them. People, money, power, are not my objects. I desire to know nothing but JESUS CHRIST, and him crucified, and to be a willing pilgrim for his great name’s sake. At present this is the language of my heart,

LORD, obediently I’d go,
Gladly leaving all below.

I intreat you to pray that my faith fail not. LORD, increase it for thy infinite mercy’s sake! We have blessed seasons here: the glory of the LORD fills our new tabernacle. If possible, I shall send the books you desire to Leeds. I hope you find your present illness sanctified. That is a sign of special love.――Adieu. I am in great haste. But with greater love, I subscribe myself, dear Mr. W――――,
Yours most affectionately in our common LORD,
